title: The ACE Challenge - Corpus, Evaluation and Results
authors: J. Eaton; N. D. Gaubitch; A. H. Moore; P. A. Naylor
venue: IEEE/ACM Trans. Audio Speech Lang. Process.
novelty_overlap: Benchmark baseline for static evaluation; lacks dynamic transitions and causal event-aligned lag tracking
notes: Foundational benchmark establishing baseline classical and ML algorithms for room parameter estimation

title: Impulse Response Data Augmentation and Deep Neural Networks for Blind Room Acoustic Parameter Estimation
novelty_overlap: Deep CNN regression on static spectrograms; does not evaluate time-varying acoustic conditions
notes: Demonstrated CNN scalability with synthetic RIR augmentation

title: Blind Reverberation Time Estimation Using a Convolutional Neural Network
novelty_overlap: Static spectrogram CNN mapping; does not track room transitions or causal settling delay
notes: Demonstrates that short speech frames suffice for static RT60 regression

title: Blind Room Acoustic Parameter Estimation using Causal Neural Networks
task: Causal blind RT60 and volume estimation
novelty_overlap: Applies causal Conv1D/TCN architecture but tests only static rooms without dynamic transition operators
notes: Direct precursor for causal TCN architecture; our work adds transition awareness and event-aligned lag metrics

title: An improved algorithm for blind estimation of reverberation time
authors: H. W. Löllmann; E. Yilmaz; M. Jeub; P. Vary
novelty_overlap: Classical maximum-likelihood sound decay tracker; highly sensitive to continuous non-decaying signals
notes: Benchmark for classical causal DSP decay estimation

title: A Single-Channel Non-Intrusive Metric for Direct-to-Reverberant Ratio Estimation
authors: P. M. Delgado Parada et al.
venue: IEEE/ACM Trans. Audio Speech Lang. Process.
novelty_overlap: Focuses on static non-intrusive DRR feature extraction; lacks causal temporal tracking
notes: Benchmark for classical and feature-based DRR estimation

title: Online Dynamic Room Acoustics Tracking
venue: IEEE/ACM Trans. Audio Speech Lang. Process.
novelty_overlap: Tracks complete FIR RIR coefficients via Kalman/LMS rather than estimating acoustic summary parameters (RT60/DRR)
notes: Focuses on adaptive filter convergence rather than blind acoustic parameter regression

title: Blind Dynamic Acoustic Parameter Estimation in Virtual Reality Environments
authors: A. Genovese; F. Antonacci; A. Sarti
task: Dynamic acoustic parameter estimation in VR
novelty_overlap: Explores dynamic crossfading in VR spaces but lacks source-event alignment and hard-switch transfer evaluation
notes: Closest contemporary work to SpatialMind-RoomShift application domain

title: New Method of Measuring Reverberation Time
novelty_overlap: Mathematical ground-truth foundation for energy decay curves via backward integration
notes: Defines ground-truth label generation for our RIR pipeline

title: Pyroomacoustics: A Python package for audio room simulation and array processing
authors: R. Scheibler; E. Bezzam; I. Dokmanić
novelty_overlap: Engine used to generate ground-truth shoebox RIRs with configurable absorption and geometry
notes: Open-source image source model implementation used in our Phase 0 verification
